title: fix(daemon): exclude maintenance commands from Gateway discovery
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes managed Gateway discovery treating standard maintenance commands such as `openclaw gateway install` as Gateway servers, which can unnecessarily block artifact preparation.

## User Impact

Recognized OpenClaw maintenance commands no longer appear as extra Gateway servers. Selected services, custom wrappers, ambiguous arguments, and incomplete observations remain guarded.

## Why This Change Was Made

Discovery now checks the OpenClaw CLI entrypoint and child command. Loaded systemd candidates use the existing structured command-location reader, which preserves argument boundaries without reading service credentials.

## Evidence

- Baseline regression: 2 failures and 13 passes; both failures wrongly included maintenance services.
- Final focused validation: 28 tests passed across discovery and loaded-unit inventory, including live-artifact refusal and custom-wrapper cases.
- Service typecheck, focused typed lint, formatting, line-cap ratchet, and exact shrink-only mock baseline check passed. Independent review has no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- The live host still refuses artifact preparation for unverified custom maintenance wrappers. This change does not claim to resolve the separate config.patch CI timeout; that local replay was stopped before tests began.
